title: OpenAI unveils low-cost AI model, a day after shelving Astra upgrade
summary: OpenAI launched a new mid-range artificial intelligence model Tuesday at one-fifth the cost of its flagship offering, one day after scrapping an upgraded version deemed unreliable.
